   ```javascript
   state: {
     initialized: false,
     currentView: 'home',
     previousView: null,
     detailsOriginView: null,

     activeDetailItem: null,
     focusedElement: null
   },
   ```
   Directly introduces `detailsOriginView: null` to track the catalog route from which the content detail view was opened.

2. **Catalog Origin Preservation (`app/js/app.js` lines 153–159)**:
   ```javascript
   if (viewName === 'details') {
     if (this.state.currentView !== 'details' && this.state.currentView !== 'player') {
       this.state.detailsOriginView = this.state.currentView;
     }
   } else if (viewName !== 'player') {
     this.state.detailsOriginView = null;
   }
   ```
   - Sets `detailsOriginView` to `currentView` when transitioning to `'details'` from any non-details, non-player view (such as `'home'`, `'movies'`, `'series'`, or `'search'`).
   - If transitioning to `'details'` from `'details'` (related titles) or `'player'` (playback exit), `detailsOriginView` is faithfully preserved.
   - If transitioning to any other screen (e.g. user selects a different tab from the header nav), `detailsOriginView` is safely cleared to prevent stale state.

3. **Safe Player Exit (`app/js/app.js` lines 247–251)**:
   ```javascript
   exitPlayer: function () {
     var returnView = this.state.previousView || 'home';
     if (returnView === 'player') returnView = 'home';
     this.switchView(returnView);
   },
   ```
   Guards against returning to `'player'` if `previousView` was `'player'`.

4. **Hierarchical Back Navigation & Loop Guard (`app/js/app.js` lines 350–363)**:
   ```javascript
   handleBackNavigation: function () {
     if (this.state.currentView === 'player') {
       this.exitPlayer();
     } else if (this.state.currentView === 'details') {
       var returnView = this.state.detailsOriginView || this.state.previousView || 'home';
       if (returnView === 'details' || returnView === 'player') returnView = 'home';
       this.state.detailsOriginView = null;
       this.switchView(returnView);
     } else if (this.state.currentView !== 'home') {
       this.switchView('home');
     } else {
       console.log('[CinejoyApp] Back pressed on home view. (webOS app exit threshold)');
     }
   },
   ```
   - If in `'player'`: delegates to `exitPlayer()`.
   - If in `'details'`: resolves `returnView` from `detailsOriginView`, then `previousView`, defaulting to `'home'`. Defensively prevents both infinite self-loops (`returnView === 'details'`) and ping-pong traps (`returnView === 'player'`) by coercing them to `'home'`. Resets `detailsOriginView` to `null`.
   - If in any catalog view (`'movies'`, `'series'`, `'search'`): unrolls hierarchically to `'home'`.
   - If already in `'home'`: logs the webOS app exit threshold without altering state or throwing errors.
